title: Visita create/list panel and conversacion activity log on lead show
description: Add two advisor-facing panels to the LeadShow page. (1) Visitas panel: a collapsible list of past visits for this lead (fecha, propiedad name, resultado, notas) with a 'Registrar visita' create form (lead_id auto-set, propiedad_id select from propiedades list, fecha date picker, resultado text, notas textarea). Visitas are advisor-only, never synced. (2) Conversaciones panel: a read-only chronological chat-style activity log of bot/lead messages sourced from the conversaciones table (append-only, synced by TASK-013). Messages display rol (bot|lead) with visual differentiation. Both panels live inside the LeadAside or as tabs on LeadShow.
acceptance_criteria: src/components/atomic-crm/leads/VisitaCreateForm.tsx renders a form with fields: propiedad_id (select), fecha (date), resultado (text), notas (textarea); submits via dataProvider.create('visitas', ...)
src/components/atomic-crm/leads/VisitasList.tsx lists visitas for the current lead ordered by fecha DESC, showing propiedad nombre, fecha, resultado
Both VisitaCreateForm and VisitasList are visible on LeadShow for users with write_visits permission (asesor, manager, admin)
src/components/atomic-crm/leads/ConversacionLog.tsx renders conversaciones for the lead in chronological order; bot messages visually distinct from lead messages (different bubble alignment/color)
ConversacionLog is visible to all authenticated users with read access to the lead
FakeRest: VisitasList and ConversacionLog render correctly with the fake data from TASK-008 generators

non_functional_requirements.performance: ConversacionLog loads last 100 messages in <200ms using conversaciones_by_lead view with LIMIT
non_functional_requirements.security: Visita create is blocked for users without write_visits permission; conversaciones are read-only for all roles
non_functional_requirements.scalability: ConversacionLog paginates: loads 50 messages, 'load more' button for older messages
